assignmentHtml.task:
全面调查 T-Series 的 YouTube 频道。查明以下事项：

  1. 其稳定频道 ID（@TSeries）及规范 URL。
  2. 运营方：由哪家公司运营（Super Cassettes Industries / T-Series），该公司由谁所有（Sukesh Mukherjee / Gulshan Kumar 家族）。
  3. 频道创建日期，以及目前仍公开的最早上传视频。
  4. 运营地点（印度 Gurugram）及频道显示的国家。
  5. 主要语言（以印地语为主，也包括英语、旁遮普语）。
  6. 主要内容类别（印度音乐视频）。
  7. 内容供应模式：唱片公司提供的授权音乐曲库。
  8. 是否存在收购、品牌更名或值得关注的历史。
  9. 代表性系列／作品，以及将其与该频道关联起来的证据。提供直接来源 URL。
assignmentHtml.context: 本任务用于制作全球观看量最高的 50 个 YouTube 频道图谱。根据 Communitrics 于 2026 年 9 月 2 日的快照，T-Series 排名第 1，历史累计观看量约为 353B（3530 亿）次。我们只需要可核实的事实，并附来源链接。
assignmentHtml.expected_output: 一份关于 T-Series 的结构化资料，包含全部要求的字段，尽可能为每个字段附上来源 URL。

answerHtml:
T-Series YouTube Channel Dossier

(1) Channel ID and Canonical URL:

  • Channel ID: UCq-Fj5jknLsUf-MWSy4_brA
  • Canonical handle URL: https://www.youtube.com/@tseries
  • Legacy channel URL: https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCq-Fj5jknLsUf-MWSy4_brA
    Source: https://www.youtube.com/@tseries/about (confirmed 'Channel URL: www.youtube.com/@tseries'); also visible in Google search result snippets.

(2) Operator and Ownership:

  • Operating company: Super Cassettes Industries Private Limited (doing business as T-Series)
  • Founder: Gulshan Kumar (established 11 July 1983)
  • Current principal owner/operator: Bhushan Kumar (son of Gulshan Kumar), Chairman & Managing Director
  • Co-leader: Krishan Kumar (younger brother of Gulshan Kumar)
  • IMPORTANT CORRECTION: No person named 'Sukesh Mukherjee' appears in any source connected to T-Series or Super Cassettes Industries ownership. The task prompt's suggestion of 'Sukesh Mukherjee / Gulshan Kumar family' is not supported by evidence. The actual ownership rests with the Kumar family through SCIL.
    Sources: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/T-Series_(company); https://www.quora.com/Who-is-the-owner-of-the-T-series-YouTube-channel; https://www.hollywoodreporter.com/business/digital/bollywood-music-giant-t-series-sets-youtube-channel-world-record-1214361/

(3) Channel Creation Date and Earliest Upload:

  • Channel created (joined YouTube): 13 March 2006
  • First video upload: Late 2010 per Wikipedia; January 1, 2011 per Digiday
  • Earliest still-public upload: Cannot be definitively identified without direct access to sorted channel video listings. The channel has ~27,130 videos and much early content may have been replaced or taken down. A candidate for earliest surviving video surfaced in search results ('Kaay Kaay (Live Version)'), but this appears to be a re-upload rather than the original 2010/2011 upload.
    Sources: https://www.youtube.com/@tseries/about (join date); https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/T-Series_(company) (joined 13 March 2006, uploads started late 2010); https://digiday.com/future-of-tv/inside-t-series-and-the-power-of-youtube-in-india/ (first video January 1, 2011)

(4) Operating Location and Displayed Country:

  • Displayed country: India (confirmed on @tseries/about page)
  • Primary headquarters: B-32, New Link Road, Andheri (W), Mumbai, Maharashtra 400053, India
  • Secondary office: Plot Number -1, Sec -16 A, Film City, Noida, UP 201301
  • Note: Guinness World Records describes T-Series as 'Delhi-based' (founding location), while LinkedIn/Wikipedia list Mumbai as primary HQ. The task prompt's mention of Gurugram is not confirmed by primary sources; Pitchbook listed Gurgaon but this conflicts with LinkedIn, Wikipedia, and ZoomInfo which all point to Mumbai.
    Sources: https://www.youtube.com/@tseries/about; https://in.linkedin.com/company/tseries; https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/T-Series_(company); https://www.guinnessworldrecords.com/news/2019/5/t-series-becomes-the-first-youtube-channel-to-surpass-100-million-subscribers

(5) Main Languages:

  • Hindi (primary), with occasional English and Punjabi content. Also regional channels for Bhojpuri, Tamil, Telugu, Marathi, Bengali, Kannada, Malayalam, Gujarati, and others.
    Source: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/T-Series_(company)

(6) Primary Content Category:

  • Music — specifically Indian/Bollywood music videos and film trailers
    Source: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_most-viewed_YouTube_channels (Content category: Music); https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/T-Series_(company)

(7) Content Supply Model:

  • Licensed music catalog from record label. T-Series holds exclusive rights to ~200,000 titles, 50,000+ music videos, and 15,000 hours of music across 15 languages. They license their copyrighted sound recordings and audio-visual songs to digital platforms, broadcasters, and third parties. YouTube is one distribution channel among several (TV licensing and Amazon are larger revenue sources). The company joined IPRS (Indian Performing Right Society) in March 2021, formalizing its publishing catalogue representation.
    Sources: https://variety.com/2021/music/asia/t-series-indian-performing-right-society-1234940762/; https://www.tseries.com/publishing; https://digiday.com/future-of-tv/inside-t-series-and-the-power-of-youtube-in-india/

(8) Acquisitions, Rebrands, and Notable History:

  • No acquisitions or rebrands identified. T-Series has always operated as Super Cassettes Industries / T-Series.
  • Key milestones:
    • 1983: Founded by Gulshan Kumar in Delhi as a cassette tape business
    • 1984: Purchased first legitimate film soundtrack (Lallu Ram)
    • 1988: Breakthrough with Qayamat Se Qayamat Tak soundtrack
    • 1990: Aashiqui soundtrack becomes best-selling Indian album of all time (~20M copies)
    • 1997: Gulshan Kumar assassinated by D-Company mafia; Bhushan Kumar (age 20) takes over
    • 2007: Filed copyright lawsuit against YouTube; settled January 2011
    • 2011: Official partnership with YouTube formed after settlement
    • 2017: Became most-viewed YouTube channel (surpassed PewDiePie)
    • 2019: First channel to reach 100M subscribers; PewDiePie rivalry settled
    • 2021: First channel to reach 200M subscribers; joined IPRS
    • 2024: Overtaken by MrBeast as most-subscribed channel
    • As of Aug 2026: ~353B lifetime views, ~314M subscribers (second most-subscribed)
      Sources: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/T-Series_(company); https://www.guinnessworldrecords.com/news/2019/5/t-series-becomes-the-first-youtube-channel-to-surpass-100-million-subscribers; https://dontcallitbollywood.com/2018/09/12/hindi-film-101-a-history-of-t-series-the-worlds-most-popular-youtube-channel/

(9) Representative Series/Work:

  • Kesariya (Brahmastra) — one of the channel's most-viewed individual videos (~619M views), demonstrating the Bollywood soundtrack model
  • Aashiqui (1990) — the foundational franchise; both the film and its soundtrack defined T-Series' rise
  • Qayamat Se Qayamat Tak (1988) — first major breakthrough soundtrack
  • 'Hit Videos' playlist (PL095CA373D64B70C0) featured prominently on the channel's homepage
  • Related sub-channels: T-Series Bhakti Sagar (devotional), T-Series Tamil, T-Series Punjabi, etc., each extending the licensed catalog into regional categories
    Sources: https://www.youtube.com/@tseries/about (Hit Videos playlist link); https://kworb.net/youtube/topvideos.html (Kesariya view count); https://dontcallitbollywood.com/2018/09/12/hindi-film-101-a-history-of-t-series-the-worlds-most-popular-youtube-channel/

Unresolved issues:

  • Exact title/date of earliest still-public upload cannot be verified without direct YouTube channel access (page returns 401 Unauthorized error).
  • Task prompt's reference to 'Sukesh Mukherjee' as an owner is contradicted by all evidence; no person by that name is connected to T-Series ownership.
  • Task prompt's reference to 'Gurugram' as operating location is not supported; primary evidence points to Mumbai (Andheri West) as HQ, with secondary Noida office.

evidence.snippet: Super Cassettes Industries Private Limited, doing business as T-Series, is an Indian record label and film studio founded by Gulshan Kumar on 11 July 1983. Owner: Gulshan Kumar (1983–1997), Bhushan Kumar (1997–present). T-Series joined YouTube on 13 March 2006, but only started uploading videos in late 2010. Headquarters: Mumbai, India. The T-Series channel primarily features content in the Hindi language, and occasionally several other languages including Bhojpuri, Punjabi and English.
evidence.supports: Ownership structure (Kumar family), founding date, YouTube creation date, HQ Mumbai, languages, content type

evidence.snippet: T-Series operates a vast music library of 200,000 titles, including more than 50,000 music videos, and 15,000 hours of music across 15 Indian languages. Joined IPRS... T-Series will bring more value to IPRS... Copyright is in the heart and soul of what T-Series creates, said chair and managing director Bhushan Kumar.
evidence.supports: Content supply model (licensed catalog of 200K titles), ownership by Bhushan Kumar

evidence.snippet: On January 1, 2011, it aired its first video on YouTube. T-Series today runs 29 different channels on YouTube, with 176 million total subscribers. Our promotion strategy is YouTube first... The company's revenue now mostly comes from platforms: YouTube is No. 3, after content licensing to TV channels and Amazon.
evidence.supports: First upload date January 1, 2011; content supply via licensing; multi-channel network structure
